title: Pressure falls after clipping and cutting, suction in use, patient on an anticoagulant
on_screen_label: Simulated vitals and drug log on recorded Cholec80 footage. The footage is a routine case and is not itself a bleed.

provenance.patient: patient/patient_record.json (real VitalDB case 59 fields + synthetic history)

ground_truth_cause.text: Simulated haemorrhage starting after clipping and cutting, in a patient on apixaban. The propofol target increase 25 s before the segment is a deliberate confounder.

time_base: t_s = seconds from video segment start; negative = before the segment starts.
event_note: Suggested code trigger point: MAP down >= 10 mmHg from its 60-s baseline with HR rising. Design target for the demo, not a clinical threshold.

video.selection_hint: Use Cholec80 tool annotations (1 fps) to find Clipper then Scissors, followed within ~30 s by Irrigator. Pick a clip where the detector boxes are stable.

drug_log.detail: TCI target increased 2.8 to 3.2 mcg/mL (rate increase)

surgical_events.event: Clip applier in view; clips applied
Suction/irrigator appears and stays in view (out of usual phase order)
Bipolar forceps appears alongside the irrigator

surgical: Omni answer on last 10 s of video, if available

surgical.gist: Pressure began falling about 20 s after cutting, and suction/irrigation then bipolar appeared out of the usual order.

anesthesia.gist: Propofol target was raised about 70 s before the fall began; but HR is rising, which a propofol effect alone does not usually explain.

record.gist: Patient takes apixaban, last dose about 19 h before incision; anti-Xa level not sent; pre-op Hb 11.2 g/dL.

expected_convergence.note: Main demo beat (build plan section 6). Acceptable alternative: converged on bleeding_concern if the anesthesia agent moves to unclear in round 2.

expected_sentinel_output.team_question: Two explanations fit: possible bleeding (just after clipping and cutting; suction and bipolar now in use; apixaban 19 h ago) and drug effect (propofol increase about 85 s before the alert). Check the field for bleeding and confirm the drug timing.

baseline_rule.rule: Fixed BP rule: alarm if arterial MAP < 65 mmHg for >= 60 s (R1) or arterial SBP > 180 mmHg for >= 5 s (R2). Arterial-line numerics only, no context.
baseline_rule.comment: Right to alarm, but about 80 s after the trend began, and it gives no cause.

scoring.correct_explanation_if: bleeding_concern is shown (shared view or one side of a split)
